IT Security Advisory - SEC-2026087

Date: 2026-05-17 | Severity: HIGH | Status: In Progress
Affected: API Gateway

Summary:
Exposed debug endpoint

Technical Details:
Debug endpoint returns stack traces

Impact:
Service disruption risk

Required Actions:
1. Patch library to v1.2.4 (Owner: Security Team, Due: 2026-11-28)
2. Update firewall rules (Owner: Security Team, Due: 2026-06-18)
3. Update runbook (Owner: Platform Team, Due: 2026-11-09)

Workaround:
Route via VPN

References:
- CVE-2026-84636
- Internal ticket: SEC-3463
